active_player_definition: listed on a tournament roster for an eligible event with at least one valid match in the 90 days before the snapshot; chosen so optional appearance-payload coverage does not define activity
analysis_name: Building Public Rankings, Part I evaluation

eligibility.valid_outcome: non-bye with a winner and loser

timestamp_treatment.reason: the repository converter otherwise assigns a global/current timestamp to missing match times, which is invalid for temporal evaluation

dataset.unique_player_definition: players resolved into at least one valid decided match; roster-only count reported separately

other_model_parameters.Bradley_Terry: team-average player effects, L2 logistic regression, C=1.0, no intercept
other_model_parameters.OpenSkill: openskill.models.PlackettLuce defaults; sequential match updates in timestamp order
other_model_parameters.win_rate: prior 90 days; per-player Beta(1,1) smoothing; team mean logit

outcome_shuffle.procedure: independent p=.5 reversal of each pre-vote match; recompute full LOOPR including tick-tock

participation.partial_appearance_treatment: appearance override is side-specific; the other side falls back to roster
participation.substitution_limitation: per-match appearance coverage is incomplete, so unobserved substitutions cannot be recovered
participation.treatment: use per-match appearances for a side when present; otherwise use that tournament/team roster

plus_vote.automatic_sendouq_admissions: not present; source contains PlusVotingResult peer-vote rows
plus_vote.candidate_status: suggested=True is an official newly suggested candidate; False is an incumbent
plus_vote.historical_rule: pass at >=60% approval; database view encoded mean +/-1 vote score >= 0.2
plus_vote.inclusion: candidate roster-active in prior 90 days; all methods evaluated on the same candidates, with declared population-neutral values for unseen players
plus_vote.uncertainty: candidate bootstrap stratified by tier, status, and outcome; 2,000 repetitions
plus_vote.vote_percentage: not exported in available CSVs; continuous analysis omitted

prediction.calibration: one positive temperature fit only to raw winner-score differences from earlier out-of-sample tournaments; minimum 200 matches and 5 tournaments
prediction.low_history_players: retained and shrunk by each method's native/default prior; no test-set coverage filter
prediction.training: all eligible matches with timestamps strictly before the held-out tournament's information cutoff; held-out tournament excluded
prediction.update: ratings recomputed before every held-out tournament and frozen within that tournament

protocol_status: revised analysis; historical reproduction is reported separately
